provenance: Synthetic scenario (not a live Smartsheet capture) exercising INC-03's deletion-diff for the weekly deep run: a sheet whose full read no longer contains a row that pipeline_memory.row_state holds from a prior run. Modeled on the sheet/row-id shapes used across tests/fixtures/mem04/*.json and tests/fixtures/incremental/abbreviated_sheet_response.json, but deliberately NOT a raw Smartsheet SDK response capture -- this fixture drives pipeline_memory.reader.get_row_state_row_ids / pipeline_memory.writer.mark_rows_deleted's diff logic directly (stored row-id set vs. this run's live row-id set), which needs no Smartsheet API shape at all.

zero_row_sheet_scenario.description: A sibling sheet whose full read returned zero rows this run -- MUST be skipped with a warning, never treated as 'every row deleted' (T-11-30).
